rows.text: Information on the meeting of the Monetary Policy Council on December
The Monetary Policy Council held its meeting on December 18-19, 2001.
The Council was submitted the materials the Ministry of Finance, banks and research institutes.
On this basis, the Council discussed inflation; tendencies in the area of money supply, lending and interest rates; external conditions and the situation in the balance of payments, real
I. Inflation, inflation expectations.
1. The consumer price index on the twelve-month scale lowered from 4.0% a month before to 3.6%.
However, 58% of this drop are justified by the factors that may be temporary, i.e. changes of foodstuffs and fuel prices.
2. In November this year, the sold industrial output prices were lower by 0.4% than in October this year (a month before they lowered by 0.6%).
The biggest price drop has been noted in the production of coke and the petroleum refining products (by 5.6%).

3. In the survey made at the beginning of December this year, the future inflation expectations of individuals worsened.
The percentage of the most pessimistic individuals forecasting that the prices will grow faster than currently increased by 6.2 percentage points (to 20.0%).
The inflation rate expected by bank analysts at the end of the year lowered from 4.2% a month before to 4.0%.
The inflation expected in the 11-month horizon lowered by 0.1 percentage point and amounted to 4.7%.
In November this year, the growth pace of consumer goods and services prices decreased on the twelve-month scale.
However, it mainly resulted from factors that may be temporary - changes of foodstuffs and fuel prices.
The sold industrial output prices were lower than a month before and lower than a year before.
